{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
valid_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue for valid completed orders
mean_revenue = valid_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Number of valid completed orders: {valid_completed.shape[0]}")
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
